name: S K International Export Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2018, SK International Export 
Ltd is in the business of garment manufacturing.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of women's and men’s apparel including silk, viscose, cotton, polyester, 
 wool, and several blends. It also entered in the ethnic wear category by developing trendy dupattas at affordable prices.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.41 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -19.5% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -11.1% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.05 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 32.4 to 58.5 days.
Working capital days have increased from 164 days to 259 days
